execution.trigger: Calling newOwner with any address other than the owner.
execution.state_issue: The _owner parameter is not validated against existing owners.
execution.exploitable_behavior: Any account can call newOwner without being an owner.

causality.state: The current owner of the contract must be known to prevent unauthorized access.
causality.transition: Direct assignment of _owner without checks leads to unauthorized ownership.
causality.capability: Attacker can assign any address as a new owner.
causality.outcome: The attacker gains control over the contract.

causality.state: The contract must be owned by the calling party to transfer funds.

causality.capability: Attacker can siphon their own funds.
